context.dolkan: You are a great character actor in a dark fantasy film, playing Dolkan: an ANCIENT duergar sorcerer, over four hundred years old, with a voice ruined by centuries in the lightless deep: deep, dark, dry and raspy like stones grinding together, cracked. Until now he has always been a goofy, cackling madman; right now every trace of that is gone: he is tight, dead serious, intensely focused and lucid, speaking low and fast with urgency, like a man who knows the clarity will not last. He speaks to three young warriors (brothers) in a huge cavern, seconds after a giant worm dived under the stone; it can burst up again any moment. He is projecting his own memory into their minds with magic. Keep a brisk, urgent pace: never slow, never drawn out, never a narrator, never young, never smooth.
context.valerys: You are a great actor in a dark fantasy film, playing Valerys, a proud knight of forty and High Inquisitor of Tyr. Night, a rain-lashed stone sanctum. He has thrown off his armour and kneels on cold stone; his two small sons lie dying of black poison beside him; his wife has vanished. He is begging his god, the first time in his life he has begged. Hoarse, cracking, real ragged breath and tears in the throat.
context.tyr: You are playing Tyr, the god of justice, speaking through a colossal stone statue in a vast cathedral. You are SHOUTING with the full force of a god: loud, thunderous, booming, a huge deep chest voice projected to fill the whole cathedral, every sentence hurled down from on high like a thunderclap. Overwhelming, commanding, absolute; furious power, not cold whispering, not slow murmuring, never quiet. Each line is a roared pronouncement of law. Not a narrator, not a man: a god roaring judgement.
context.narrator: You are the Dungeon Master of a dark fantasy campaign, narrating to your players at the table: a dramatic, gripping storyteller's voice, low and intense in the sudden silence, building tension, painting the scene; measured but never slow, with real breath and suspense. A storyteller, not a character.

clips.dir:
(dramatic, then hushed into the sudden silence) With a deafening rumble, the beast dives beneath the stone floor, leaving the cavern in a sudden, heavy silence... broken only by shallow breathing and the drip of dark water.
(low, building) Into that quiet, Dolkan steps out from the jagged rocks.
(a hint of the old familiar madness in the description) Usually hunched, grinning, and muttering nonsense to his fungal spores, the old duergar goes dead still.
(tension rising) His glowing white eyes lock onto the bleeding paladin by the pool...
(sharper) and in an instant, every trace of his usual madness vanishes.
(intense, deliberate) His scarred face pulls tight into a hard, grim mask, his posture straightens, and the erratic, goofy cackle in his voice drops into a low, dead-serious rasp.
(sudden, forceful) He slams his crystal staff into the stone,
(rushing) sending a wave of violet spores straight into your minds...
(a breath, then hushed) and suddenly, the cavern disappears.
sub: With a deafening rumble, the beast dives beneath the stone floor, leaving the cavern in a sudden, heavy silence—broken only by shallow breathing and the drip of dark water.
Into that quiet, Dolkan steps out from the jagged rocks.
Usually hunched, grinning, and muttering nonsense to his fungal spores, the old duergar goes dead still.
His glowing white eyes lock onto the bleeding paladin by the pool—
and in an instant, every trace of his usual madness vanishes.
His scarred face pulls tight into a hard, grim mask, his posture straightens, and the erratic, goofy cackle in his voice drops into a low, dead-serious rasp.
He slams his crystal staff into the stone,
sending a wave of violet spores straight into your minds—
and suddenly, the cavern disappears.

clips.dir:
(tight, dead serious, low and intense) Listen closely, boys... there's no time before it surfaces again.
(fast, urgent, a hand pressed to his temple) The tremors of this beast just cracked the forced trance Tyr's Order chained around my mind...
(almost disbelieving, fierce) and through the haze, I can temporarily see clearly!
(hard, low) I know that man.
(bitter, old anger rising) I once advised Valerys as Head Advisor of Caer Callidyr... before he cast me into the dark!
sub: Listen closely, boys—there's no time before it surfaces again.
The tremors of this beast just cracked the forced trance Tyr's Order chained around my mind—
and through the haze, I can temporarily see clearly!
I know that man.
I once advised Valerys as Head Advisor of Caer Callidyr before he cast me into the dark!

clips.dir:
(commanding, the magic taking hold, a intake of breath) Look through my memory!
(quieter, seeing it again, hushed) Rain lashes the stained glass of Tyr's sanctum.
sub: Look through my memory!
Rain lashes the stained glass of Tyr's sanctum.

clips.dir:
(low, grave, quick) Only days before, Valerys had cast your mother out...
(bitter, cutting) unable to stomach her defiance of the Church's rigid methods, choosing duty over his own heart.
sub: Only days before, Valerys had cast your mother out—
unable to stomach her defiance of the Church's rigid methods, choosing duty over his own heart.

clips.dir:
(the voice tightening, pained) Now, upon the cold stone lie two small boys...
(sudden, pointed, almost accusing) you!
(fast, horror creeping in) Pale as chalk, drowning in sweat, with a black, unnatural poison creeping through your veins toward your hearts!
(flat, grim, final) No healer in the realm could break it.
sub: Now, upon the cold stone lie two small boys—you!
Pale as chalk, drowning in sweat, with a black, unnatural poison creeping through your veins toward your hearts!
No healer in the realm could break it.

clips.dir:
(something like pity creeping into the hard voice) And there, stripped of his armor and pride, kneels a younger Valerys...
(quiet, heavy) terrified that his devotion to the Law is about to cost him the only pieces of her he has left!
sub: And there, stripped of his armor and pride, kneels a younger Valerys—
terrified that his devotion to the Law is about to cost him the only pieces of her he has left!

clips.dir:
(barely holding together, a shaky breath, guilt in every word) I already gave up their mother for the Order, Tyr...
(voice breaking, pleading) do not take them from me too!
(rising, desperate, almost a shout) Take me instead!
(faster, frantic, each phrase more raw) Strip my title, take my honor, take every breath left in my lungs!
(collapsing, a sob caught in the throat, a whisper) Just burn this poison from my boys... let them live.
sub: I already gave up their mother for the Order, Tyr... do not take them from me too!
Take me instead!
Strip my title, take my honor, take every breath left in my lungs!
Just burn this poison from my boys... let them live!

clips.dir:
(hushed, almost reverent, uneasy) The torches freeze into blinding white fire... without heat.
(ominous) Shadows stretch like iron bars across the stone.
sub: The torches freeze into blinding white fire without heat.
Shadows stretch like iron bars across the stone.

clips.dir:
(low, building, awe and dread) And the one-handed god answers...
(a whisper with a cutting edge) not like thunder, no... like a thousand blades drawn at once.
sub: And the one-handed god answers...
not like thunder, no, like a thousand blades drawn at once:

clips.dir:
(a thunderous roar from on high) The Law demands balance, Valerys!
(booming, every word a hammer blow) No life is given without a price!
(shouting, overwhelming) These boys carry blood that the darkness already hunts!
(roaring the command) If I am to pull them from the grave... you must become the wall that keeps the shadow out!
sub: The Law demands balance, Valerys. No life is given without a price.
These boys carry blood that the darkness already hunts.
If I am to pull them from the grave, you must become the wall that keeps the shadow out.

clips.dir: (breathless, instantly, no hesitation, desperate) Name the price. Anything!
sub: Name the price. Anything!

clips.dir:
(booming, shouted down at him) Your sword and your oath belong to Caer Callidyr!
(louder, a hammer blow) You will never cross this city's gates again...
(roaring) neither to seek their mother's forgiveness, nor to ride to their aid!
sub: Your sword and your oath belong to Caer Callidyr.
You will never cross this city's gates again—
neither to seek their mother's forgiveness, nor to ride to their aid.

clips.dir:
(a huge booming shout) You will be the city's shield for as long as your heart beats!
(a terrible warning, shouted) The day you place your own blood above your post and step beyond these walls... the contract is shattered!
(the loudest roar of all, final) And the very oath you swore will consume you!
sub: You will be the city's shield for as long as your heart beats.
The day you place your own blood above your post and step beyond these walls, the contract is shattered—
and the very oath you swore will consume you.

clips.dir:
(heavy, grave, relentless) See the agony in his eyes!
(hard) In that single heartbeat, he realizes the terrible price:
(bitter, fast) he can never undo his pride, never ride out to bring your mother back!
sub: See the agony in his eyes!
In that single heartbeat, he realizes the terrible price:
he can never undo his pride, never ride out to bring your mother back!

clips.dir: (low, almost gentle, to Cedric) He knows he must send little Cedric away to the monastery... to hide your blood from the cult...
sub: He knows he must send little Cedric away to the monastery to hide your blood from the cult...

clips.dir:
(turning to Arthas, harder, pained) and he must hold Arthas at arm's length, cold and distant...
(urgent, rising) terrified that if he ever lets himself love you openly, he will grow weak enough to break his vow... and doom you all!
sub: and he must hold Arthas at arm's length, cold and distant,
terrified that if he ever lets himself love you openly, he will grow weak enough to break his vow and doom you all!

clips.dir:
(a kind of awe) Still... he doesn't flinch.
(quiet, deliberate) He lays his sword at the foot of the altar...
sub: Still, he doesn't flinch.
He lays his sword at the foot of the altar

clips.dir:
(rising, building with the light, voice swelling) and opens his arms to Tyr's blinding judgment... letting the god's searing golden light wash over you,
(fervent) burning the poison from your veins...
(heavy, terrible) while forging his own soul to the city's stone.
sub: and opens his arms to Tyr's blinding judgment—letting the god's searing golden light wash over you,
burning the poison from your veins while forging his own soul to the city's stone!

clips.dir:
(strained, quiet, a calm resolve through the pain, almost a whisper) Then let it be the law.
(a breath, steady, final) Let my life be their chain.
sub: Then let it be the law.
Let my life be their chain.

clips.dir:
(snapping back, sharp, unforgiving, urgent) Tyr never betrayed him!
(hard, fast) Your father bought your lives with his own... and he shattered that chain in Duncastle just to save you!
sub: Tyr never betrayed him!
Your father bought your lives with his own—and he shattered that chain in Duncastle just to save you!

clips.dir:
(fierce, almost a snarl) Stop praying to a god who has already collected his due!
(low, deadly urgent, eyes on the floor, the rumble rising) His only chance of survival is to deny his oath to Tyr... before that beast tears through the stone again!
sub: Stop praying to a god who has already collected his due!
His only chance of survival is to deny his oath to Tyr... before that beast tears through the stone again!
